reasons: Cited text supports the compliant claim: 24.1 grants Customer an unconditional affiliate/successor assignment right without Vendor consent (only notice plus assignee assumption), matching the preferred position.

24.2 restricts Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance and indirect change-of-control transfer to Customer's reasonableness-qualified consent and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor, as preferred.
24.4 expressly negates any Vendor termination, suspension, repricing, Fee acceleration or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control, so the walk-away trigger is absent.
24.3's residual consent requirement is scoped to 'other assignments' and does not undercut the 24.1 carve-out; 13.3 aligns licence transfer with permitted assignments.
No redline or comment proposed, which is appropriate for a compliant finding; the deterministic carve-out check also passes.
